objective: Fix the polish follow-ups left after TASK-002 to TASK-004: soften the entry world fade first step, keep the avatar head in frame when jumping at the tower passage mouth, make the hero controls inert and defer game prefetch while the intro video plays, remove the load-sensitive test timeouts in the game suite, and clear the useRealtimeChat lint warning.

sred.technicalChallenge: Whether the follow camera can keep the full avatar in frame during a jump in a constrained passage mouth without reintroducing near-plane clipping or wall penetration, and whether the physics-heavy camera and clearance tests can be made deterministic under host load instead of depending on wall-clock timeouts.

acceptanceCriteria: The entry world fade first step is no larger than the previously accepted level (about 2.3x the neighbour median luminance step) and the fade stays monotone.
Jumping at the tower passage mouth keeps the avatar head in frame on every sampled frame, without camera clipping or geometry occlusion.

While the intro video plays, the covered hero controls are inert and not keyboard focusable, and game prefetch does not start until the intro ends; after the intro, Play focus and prefetch behave as before.
The game test suite passes without timeouts when run under heavy host load, and the useRealtimeChat lint warning is gone with npm run lint reporting zero warnings.
Required checks pass, QA approves, records are committed and a pull request is opened.
constraints: Work in the TASK-005 isolation only; base commit b9776c1 on master.

approvals.scope: Direct user request: 'fix the polish follow-ups'.
